milestones.title: Reusable API argument validation
milestones.objective: Provide a reusable, consistent argument validation layer for the pipr API functions.

features.title: Restore live ppp_version = 2011 API tests
features.notes: The live ppp_version = 2011 tests in test-get_cp.R and test-get_cp_ki.R were replaced with mocked URL-assertion tests because the PIP API errors (HTTP 500 / non-JSON) for 2011 requests. Restore the live assertions (res$poverty_line == 1.9) once the API supports ppp_version = 2011. See .cg-docs/solutions/bugs/2026-09-25-ppp-version-2011-api-test-failures.md
